intro.heading: I build custom websites that are clear and easy to use
intro.tagline: No unnecessary extras. Every website is unique. I can take inspiration from what you like and adapt it to what you need
intro.servicesOverview: I build websites tailored to each situation: from simple pages to interactive projects with forms, search features, dynamic content, or even text-only websites. Whatever you need, it can be planned and built.
intro.hostingNote: I can take care of the domain and hosting if you want to avoid the technical side, or leave everything in your hands. I can also maintain the website month by month or hand over everything (code, domain, and hosting) so it's completely yours with no dependency.

services.title: Types of websites I build
services.intro: Depending on what you need, I can create different types of websites

static.ideal: Brands that use this type of website

dynamic.description: Filters, search features, instantly updating content, smart forms, and integrations with external APIs.
dynamic.ideal: Platforms that use this type of website

hybrid.title: To manage your content
hybrid.description: A public area for customers and a private area to manage content without touching code.
hybrid.ideal: Services that use this type of website

pricing.title: About pricing:
pricing.description: Every project is different. I usually stay below market rates because I prioritize user experience and building things properly over inflating budgets. Depending on what you need, we can adjust everything with no commitment.

about.title: Who's behind this
about.intro: My name is Héctor Jarque. I started from scratch by studying DAW and building my own projects, breaking things and learning until I truly understood how websites work.
about.location: I live in Valencia. I work remotely without any issues, and if you're nearby, we can grab a coffee.
about.learning: I started without knowing anything and gradually built projects until I was able to develop complete websites and understand what happens behind every part of them.
about.honesty: I don't sell smoke and mirrors. If something can't be done, I'll tell you. If it can be done but isn't a good idea for any reason, I'll explain that clearly too.
